title: Total transition probability into a vertex
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and let $k$ be a nonnegative integer. For any vertex $v$, the sum over all starting vertices of the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $k$ neighbor indices ends at $v$ is $1$.
